_comment: Reviewed ledger categories, read by scripts/lint-ledger-categories.js (see its header). One entry per technology the engine files under CMS, CRM, Marketing Automation, Chatbot, Accessibility or Site Search with a script, meta or dom rule, plus entries that record a reviewed "no". ledger_categories is what the review says. status: reviewed (a person decided), agent-reviewed (an agent review named in reviewer; a person has not confirmed it), unreviewed. A new technology in the six, a changed category, or an unreviewed technology that produced ledger rows fails npm test. Built 2026-11-27 from the engine at main and the 2026-11 detection review (speedyu-data/detechtor-review-2026-11/evidence).
